footnote_text: Each Restricted Stock Unit ("RSU") was the economic equivalent of one Novanta Inc. common share. On November 3, 2026, the RSUs were settled in Novanta Inc. common shares.

On November 4, 2026, the Reporting Person received an automatic grant of restricted stock units ("RSUs") for 1,669.003 shares of KLA common stock. The RSUs vest on the earliest to occur of (i) November 4, 2027, (ii) immediately prior to the next annual meeting of stockholders, and (iii) ten days prior to a change of control of KLA. || The number of shares of KLA common stock includes 1,669.003 shares issuable upon vesting of RSUs.
